content.headline: Validated by the Architects of Human Health
content.subhead: See why leading physical therapists and wellness executives trust Stitch for precision-engineered, restorative sleep.

testimonials.name: Julian Thorne
testimonials.title: Chief of Physiotherapy
testimonials.quote: The structural integrity of Stitch mattresses provides the precise spinal alignment my patients need to truly recover during the night.
testimonials.image_prompt: Professional headshot of a male physical therapist in his 40s, wearing a clean charcoal sweater, soft lighting, warm clinical environment, high-end photography, cinematic depth of field.

testimonials.name: Elena Rodriguez
testimonials.title: Sleep Consultant
testimonials.quote: Stitch bridges the gap between clinical support and the soft sanctuary of a home bedroom, making wellness feel effortless.
testimonials.image_prompt: Professional headshot of a female sleep consultant in her 30s, sophisticated look, wearing a sage green silk blouse, natural office light, blurred background of a modern library, 8k resolution.

testimonials.name: Marcus Chen
testimonials.title: Executive Director
testimonials.quote: I recommend Stitch because it respects the body's natural ergonomics, turning sleep into a restorative medical asset.
testimonials.image_prompt: Professional headshot of a male medical director in his 50s, distinguished appearance, wearing a white clinical coat over a dress shirt, bright airy medical suite background, soft professional lighting.

testimonials.name: Sarah Jenkins
testimonials.title: Wellness Program Manager
testimonials.quote: Finally, a sleep solution that combines rigorous health standards with the soothing comfort of a high-end luxury retreat.
testimonials.image_prompt: Professional headshot of a female executive in her 40s, confident and warm, wearing a beige blazer, modern corporate lounge background with plants, high-end editorial style.
